howto.name: Upload an audio or video file
howto.text: Select an MP4, MP3, WAV, WebM, or other media file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Set the trim range
howto.text: Use the waveform/timeline to set precise start and end times, or type timestamps manually (e.g. 00:30 to 02:15).

howto.name: Trim and download
howto.text: Click Trim. The server extracts the selected segment without re-encoding when possible, preserving original quality.

faq.q: Can I trim audio files too?
faq.a: Yes. The tool supports both audio (MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC) and video (MP4, WebM, MOV, AVI) files.
When possible, the tool uses lossless cutting (no re-encoding) to preserve original quality. Some format combinations require re-encoding.
Precision depends on the format. MP4 can be cut to the nearest keyframe (typically within 0.5 seconds). Re-encoded output is frame-accurate.
